verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm, a professional legal-services provider rather than a software platform, so subscribing to events via registrable outbound HTTP webhooks is a category error for this kind of product. Its free blog subscriptions and internal adoption of AI legaltech are not programmatic webhook callbacks and do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
